items.headline: Lock, Smith-Njigba have Seahawks 2-0 with Darnold ahead of schedule
items.description: Seahawks coach Mike Macdonald said QB Sam Darnold could return to practice this week and did not rule out the possibility of him playing next Sunday. In the meantime, backup Drew Lock has Seattle 2-0, with plenty of help from receiver Jaxon Smith-Njigba.
